rules.reason: This closed NCO 2026 call funds coordination and management of the Kenyan local-partner portfolio across the country (guide pages 2–3). Nigeria-only funded work is outside this programme; a multi-country project including Kenya needs its requested Kenyan component confirmed. This does not turn the wider KCDF foundation into a Kenya-only rule.
General grant exclusions expressly reject work without a direct benefit in the UK. This concerns benefit, not the physical location of every activity or the applicant country.

The Foundation supports B.C. First Nations language, arts and cultural heritage through Council-administered programmes. Canada is only a necessary coarse benefit condition; B.C. and First Nations programme requirements remain. This is a referral, not a direct Foundation application.
rules.localRequirement: British Columbia First Nations communities and the administering Council programme requirements.

rules.reason: The General Grant is available to eligible organisations serving residents of Mahoning and Trumbull Counties, Ohio. US benefit is necessary but insufficient; this is resident service, not a requirement that every activity physically occur in those counties.
rules.localRequirement: Residents of Mahoning or Trumbull County, Ohio.

rules.reason: FAQ 3.6 says the collaboration should primarily benefit San Francisco. US benefit is necessary but insufficient; organisations themselves need not be based in San Francisco and at least one partner work must primarily focus there.
rules.localRequirement: Primary San Francisco benefit and at least one partner whose work primarily focuses there.

rules.reason: FAQ 2.4 expressly excludes for-profit entities from participating in this collaboration. Public agencies may collaborate but cannot receive grant funds; do not exclude them from the collaboration entirely. Actual charity/fiscal sponsor status remains a separate necessary check.
Community Grants must primarily benefit Winnipeg residents, including projects taking place elsewhere. Canadian benefit alone is insufficient.
Solutions may originate abroad but must benefit, apply or adapt to Singapore. Applicant location in Singapore is a preference, not a mandatory exclusion.
India Fund supports community development for disadvantaged communities in India; local Indian NGO and FCRA requirements remain separate. Specific priority areas must be checked.
Eligible applicants must be local Indian NGOs with FCRA registration; non-Indian organisations and local branches are excluded.

rules.reason: Work must directly benefit individuals or groups within the specified UK postcode areas. This is a benefit rule, not a blanket ban on every activity outside the UK.

rules.reason: Funding requests must serve residents of the five specified Bay Area counties, not all California. Urgency and movement-building tests also apply.
rules.localRequirement: Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, San Francisco or San Mateo County residents.

rules.reason: Groups must be based in OR work across an eligible MENA country. Both base and work must be outside the list before this check can flag a conflict.

The official Creation FAQ says screening removes projects not happening in Canada. Canadian scope alone does not establish Indigenous youth leadership, stream eligibility or current intake; check with staff for cross-border traditional-territory exceptions.
Applicants must operate in OR serve Chicago. Work or beneficiary country outside the US alone is insufficient to reject; both must be outside before flagging a conflict.
rules.localRequirement: Operate in or serve Chicago; country overlap does not establish this local condition.
